payload.name: Boundary Vector Cells
payload.fact: Boundary vector cells are a type of neuron in the hippocampal formation that fire in relation to spatial boundaries.

provenance.title: Author response: RatInABox, a toolkit for modelling locomotion and neuronal activity in continuous environments
provenance.quote_or_locus: rapid online calculation of neural data for many of the known self-location or velocity selective cell types in the hippocampal formation (including place cells, grid cells, boundary vector cells, head direction cells
